clue.text: Rock? Watch bearing!

definitions.meaning: rock is slang for a precious stone such as a diamond
a watch movement runs on tiny ruby bearings named for gems

explanation.surface: A geologist's puzzled exclamation about a rock and a wristwatch.
explanation.definitionFit: A gem is called a rock in slang, and a watch's ruby pivot is a gem bearing too.

clue.text: Dive, a means of raising cutter

parts.note: a jack is a device for lifting a car
a knife is a cutter

explanation.surface: A diver uses some contraption to lift a boat called a cutter.
explanation.definitionFit: A dive in which the body bends double before straightening is named after a folding pocket blade.

clue.text: Work leader taking on seniors as metalworkers

indicators.note: the leader of the word Work is its opening letter

parts.note: elders are seniors

explanation.surface: A foreman at work takes on older employees as metalworkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Welders join metal pieces by fusing them, so they are metalworkers by trade.

clue.text: Set down, face up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a dial is a clock's face

explanation.surface: An instruction to put something down with its face upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Laid is the past tense of lay, meaning placed or set down.

clue.text: Pandora's bottom drawer?

parts.note: in the myth hope remained at the bottom of Pandora's box, and a bottom drawer is a store of linen kept by a bride-to-be

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about where the mythical Pandora kept her trousseau.
explanation.walkthrough: A bottom drawer is the British term for the collection of household linen a woman gathered before marriage; the American name for the box holding it fits Pandora, whose box kept hope inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The American name for a box of linens saved for marriage is the British bottom drawer, and hope stayed in Pandora's box.

clue.text: Dashing from the rain

definitions.meaning: dashing about means acting with rash haste or hurry
rain is water falling from the sky

explanation.surface: Someone runs in to escape a downpour.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means rash haste as well as rain, snow or hail falling from clouds.

clue.text: Masterstroke of company on the rise?

parts.note: something on the rise is going up

explanation.surface: A clever business move by a firm whose fortunes are improving.
explanation.definitionFit: A coup is a brilliantly successful move, a masterstroke.

clue.text: Back ack that came in last

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Back ack that came in last (7)': the wordplay END + ORSE needs a word like 'orse (horse), not 'ack'; OCR damage beyond a few letters and no source found.
annotationWithheld.clue: Back ack that came in last

clue.text: Stay to get pitched up

definitions.meaning: to stay is to linger or remain
covered in pitch, a tar-like substance, so smeared with tar

explanation.surface: Campers deciding to remain once their tent has been put up.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to linger as a verb, and as an adjective coated with tar or pitch.

clue.text: Hole in one for a sculptor

parts.note: a cell is a small cramped room, a hole
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A golfer's hole in one, celebrated by an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: Benvenuto Cellini was a Renaissance Italian goldsmith and sculptor.
explanation.definitionFit: Benvenuto Cellini was a celebrated Italian Renaissance sculptor and goldsmith.

clue.text: Upside down, butterfly makes mark on paper

parts.note: something upside down is inverted
the comma is a species of butterfly with a comma-shaped mark on its wing

explanation.surface: A butterfly landing upside down leaves a mark on a sheet of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised comma used as a quotation mark is a punctuation mark written on paper.

clue.text: English copper, road making here in South America

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: making suggests the word road is being made into something new, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An English policeman builds a road somewhere in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecuador is a country on the west coast of South America.

clue.text: Look around the strongest part of the castle

definitions.text: the strongest part of the castle

indicators.note: turned around means the word is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to peek is to look quickly

explanation.surface: A tourist told to look around the castle's most fortified part.
explanation.definitionFit: The keep is the central fortified tower of a castle, its strongest point.

clue.text: Assist Virginia in trouble

indicators.note: in signals that one piece sits within another

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or afflict
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: A plea to help a woman named Virginia who is in difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: To avail is to help or be of use, so it can mean assist.

clue.text: Poet published in Greek a year afterwards

indicators.note: afterwards means the year comes after the earlier pieces

explanation.surface: A poet's work published in Greek translation a year later.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Gray wrote the Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Gray was an eighteenth-century English poet.

clue.text: A thick piece of wood placed at right angles to length of ship

definitions.text: at right angles to length of ship

parts.note: taken as written
a beam is a long thick piece of timber

explanation.surface: Instructions for fitting a timber beam crosswise in a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Abeam is a nautical term for a bearing at right angles to the keel.

clue.text: Reversible canoe

indicators.note: reversible says the answer reads the same either way

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A canoe that can be paddled in either direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A kayak is a type of canoe with a covered deck.

clue.text: Coming from inn, a subeditor can be rebellious

indicators.note: the answer comes from these words, their letters reorganised

explanation.surface: A journalist emerging from a pub may turn unruly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming from' rearranges INN, A and SUBEDITOR; 'can be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Insubordinate means defying authority, which is to be rebellious.

clue.text: See dry rot spreading, as something that ravages

indicators.note: spreading scatters the letters of see dry rot into a new order

explanation.surface: A homeowner notices dry rot spreading through the house, ruining it.
explanation.definitionFit: A destroyer is anything that wrecks or ravages.

clue.text: Her Majesty's platform controllers?

parts.note: Her Majesty's is a London theatre, and its platform is a stage run by backstage staff

explanation.surface: Who runs the Queen's railway platforms, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: Her Majesty's is a West End theatre in London, not the monarch; its platform is the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre staff who run backstage operations control the stage, the performing platform.

clue.text: Academic whose mate arrives early on board

definitions.text: Academic whose mate arrives early on board

parts.words: Academic whose mate arrives early on board
parts.note: in chess a quick four-move checkmate carries the name of a learned person

explanation.surface: A professor whose friend boards a ship ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: The mate is a chess checkmate, and the board a chessboard, not a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholar is an academic, and the four-move checkmate is named after one.

clue.text: Apprentices lose head becoming breadwinners

indicators.note: losing the head means the opening letter is removed

parts.note: apprentices are learners

explanation.surface: Trainees who lose their heads become the family's providers.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who earn money to support a household are its wage earners.

clue.text: Radar signal from the chopper

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A radar return picked up from a helicopter.
explanation.definitionFit: A radar echo is the reflected pulse that returns from an object.

clue.text: Small, mischievous German eleven at home

parts.note: elf is the German word for eleven
at home means in

explanation.surface: A small, naughty German football team playing at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Elfin describes something small and impish, like an elf.

clue.text: Bill's clear and sharp

parts.note: AC is the abbreviation for account, a bill
to rid is to clear

explanation.surface: Someone named Bill is both lucid and quick-witted.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrid means sharp and bitter in smell or taste.

clue.text: Uncle Remus's little brother?

parts.note: in the Uncle Remus tales, animal characters take a short dialect form of brother as a title

explanation.surface: A question about the younger sibling of the storyteller Uncle Remus.
explanation.walkthrough: Uncle Remus is the narrator of Joel Chandler Harris's folk tales featuring Brer Rabbit and Brer Fox.
explanation.definitionFit: In Uncle Remus stories the shortened dialect form of brother is used as a title.

clue.text: Fare from France (British Rail, that is)

parts.note: ie stands for id est, that is

explanation.surface: Food from France served on a British train.
explanation.walkthrough: British Rail was the UK's state railway operator.
explanation.definitionFit: Brie is a soft cheese from France, so a food or fare.

clue.text: Hilltop aspect?

definitions.meaning: the top of a hill or slope
aspect here is a person's face or expression

explanation.surface: A question about the view from the summit of a hill.
explanation.definitionFit: The brow is the crest of a hill and also the forehead, the face's look.

clue.text: Turning point for mechanics

parts.note: in mechanics a lever turns about its pivot, not a moment of change in life

explanation.surface: A crucial moment in the lives of garage mechanics.
explanation.definitionFit: The fulcrum is the pivot on which a lever turns in mechanics.

clue.text: Series of cannons where children play

definitions.meaning: in billiards a run of cannons with the balls kept close together
a room or school for small children

explanation.surface: A row of guns set up in a playroom.
explanation.walkthrough: A cannon in billiards is a shot striking two balls in succession; a nursery cannon keeps them bunched.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a billiards run of cannons and a room for young children.

clue.text: Ma insured unorthodox nanny

indicators.note: unorthodox means unconventional, so the letters of Ma insured are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mother has taken out insurance on an unconventional childminder.
explanation.definitionFit: A nursemaid is a woman employed to look after children, a nanny.

clue.text: More sage wife served in halves

indicators.note: in halves means only the first half of each word is used

explanation.surface: A clever wife serves the dish cut into halves.
explanation.definitionFit: Wiser is the comparative of wise, so it means more sage.
